name: @equin/plugin-apps-deploy-site-reports-import
description: Pulls a deployed site's visitor error reports into this computer's Reports: an hourly main-only job reads each deployment's host-only list over SSH, reduces every row to typed, clamped fields and records it as a website-visitor-error report (source website-visitor: untrusted, never auto-investigated, fenced as data when investigated by hand).
